author: lucasmmoore1316
quote: They actually improved the fidelity quite a bit in the remake. This is the best way to play the game by a fairly wide margin. I do think that some of the foliage and some other graphical touches were a little half baked. Great story, great gameplay, and decent effort at bringing the game to the next generation.
game_title: The Last of Us Part I

author: lucasmmoore1316
quote: The original game is a 10/10. This is certainly the best way to play both games; big BUT, you’d think that they could have added to the games rather than just barely improving the fidelity and adding the dualsense controller support. If this was released as a free upgrade for those that already owned the PS4 version it would be far more justifiable.

author: lucasmmoore1316
quote: Astro Bot is the true two generation leap evolution to Little Big Planet in nearly the best possible way. Forgoing the customization and cuteness for a highly catered, high fidelity and technically masterful world of tons of brilliant set levels. Nearly all of these levels are expertly crafted and thematically unique. This is the best PS5 exclusive, but not as groundbreaking as LBP1 was when it launched on PS3.

author: lucasmmoore1316
quote:
A billion dollar quadruple A game that can be summed up in 3 words: half baked story. I wish this game could receive a negative score. This company has disrespected its consumer with a technically interesting software experience packaged as a boring game with terrible characters that most people will find to be socially awkward, dull and degenerate in a basic way lacking any nuance. Jason’s voice acting was really bad, he doesn’t strike me as a man or a capable and creative criminal - just an idiot that has an unsavory obsession with his baby momma. Maybe Jason was meant to just pick up a 9-5 so he could take care of his carefree baby momma and son rather than having any role in the lives of the unfortunate millions of people that regret purchasing this game.

Here’s my question to people that have played and have gotten some enjoyment from the game (I have gotten some as well): Is this game a grand theft auto game? That’s why this deserves an abysmal score - it isn’t a GTA that has a cool and insightful story that blends brilliant characters with a well constructed narrative. We need to review bomb this game so they can fire these mentally addled writers and get to work on a new game using the same backend. Let’s shoot for a normal 4 year turnaround this time and not 13 years.
